senses.gloss:
Young,Ⓒa.Ⓓyuvan (yUnI-yuvati-tI f.), taruRa (RI f.), bAla (of trees &c. also); alpavayas, kOmAra (rI f.), aBinavavayaska; (of men) oft. ex. by dArakaH, kumAraH in comp.; ‘y(oung) sage’ munikumAraH-rakaH, fzidArakaH; ‘y(oung) warrior’ vIrapotaH, bAlavIraH, oft. by (s.) in comp.; See below; ‘y(oung) one’ SAvaH-vakaH, arBakaH, apatyaM, potaH-takaH, SiSuH, qiMBaH, pfTukaH; ‘y(oung) of an elephant’, ‘y(oung) elephant’ gajaSiSuH, kalaBaH.
Ⓝ[Young]er,Ⓒa.ⒹyavIyas, kanIyas, anujanman; ‘y(oung) brother or sister’ anujaH-jA, avarajaH-jA, anaMtarajaH-jA.
ⓃYoungster,Ⓒs.ⒹbawuH, arBakaH, kumArakaH, bAlaH.
ⓃYouth,Ⓒs.ⒹyOvanaM, tAruRyaM, pUrvaM-navaM-praTamaM-vayaH, kOmAraM-rakaM; ‘being in the prime or heyday of her y(outh)’ praTame vayasi vartamAnA, navayOvanA; (‘state of y(outh)’) yOvana-daSA-padavI, tAruRyAvasTA, yOvanakAlaH &c.
Ⓑ
 2 (Young man) yuvan m., taruRaH, bAlaH, kumAraH-rakaH, bAlajanaH, kiSoraH.
Ⓝ[Youth]ful,Ⓒa.ⒹtaruRavayaska; by potaH, bAlaH, in comp. See (a.).
Ⓝ[Youth]fulness,Ⓒs.ⒹtAruRyaM.
